enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up with left hand. Move right arm under pillow. Turn to back. Adjust pillow with right hand. Turn to right side. Move legs. Pull blanket down slightly. Continue sleeping.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Say 'Good morning' to Member 1. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Take bread and place in toaster, press lever. Place frying pan on stove, turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan, stir with spatula. Take toast from toaster. Pour milk into glasses. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Talk with Member 1. Drink milk. Pick up plates. Place plates in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 2. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt and pants. Place on bed. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Open drawer. Take out socks. Put on socks. Take shoes from closet. Put on shoes. Open work bag. Place laptop in bag. Place notebook and pens in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card on reader. Find seat. Sit down. Take out phone. Check messages. Get off bus. Walk to subway station. Descend stairs. Tap transit card on gate. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Read book. Arrive at station. Exit train. Walk to office building. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as an arts administrator, coordinating programs and meetings
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Attend morning meeting. Take notes. Discuss program details. Make phone calls to partners. Send follow-up emails. Print documents. Organize files. Attend another meeting. Take notes. Update project timeline. Coordinate with team members.

Stand up. Walk to cafeteria. Join queue. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay at cashier. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Unwrap sandwich. Take bite. Chew. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Talk with colleague. Check phone. Finish eating. Pick up tray. Return tray. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as an arts administrator, handling exhibitions and partner communications
enriched_activities.desc: Return to desk. Open email. Read messages. Call gallery. Discuss exhibition setup. Send emails to partners. Update exhibition schedule. Meet with curator. Review artwork list. Print contracts. Sign contracts. Scan documents. File paperwork. Attend conference call. Take notes. Send meeting summary. Coordinate shipping. Update database.

Leave office. Walk to subway. Enter station. Tap card. Board train. Sit. Read book. Exit train. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Greet Member 1. Wash hands. Open refrigerator and take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Chop vegetables. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil and meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Add sauce. Stir. Serve food onto plates. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Talk with Member 1. Pick up plates. Place in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Select show. Watch TV. Talk with Member 1. Adjust volume. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Take out snacks. Walk back. Sit on sofa. Eat snacks. Watch TV. Laugh. Talk with Member 1. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on freelance illustration commissions at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Open illustration software. Open file. Pick up stylus. Draw sketch. Adjust layers. Choose colors. Apply color. Save file. Check email. Reply to client. Continue drawing. Stretch arms. Drink water. Export file. Send to client. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp.

Sit at desk. Take out sketchbook. Pick up pencil. Draw lines. Erase. Draw again. Use ruler. Shade. Turn page. Draw more. Look at reference. Adjust. Put down pencil. Open drawer. Take out colored pencils. Select color. Color sketch. Blend. Sharpen pencil. Close sketchbook.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Apply soap. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Mark page. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off light. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Sleep.
